test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Three times the present age of Sujatha is 5 years more than two times the present age of Vanita. After 3 years, three times the age of Vanita will be 4 years less than four times the age of Sujatha. The age of Vanita is k years more than that of Sujatha. What is the value of k?
solution:
Given:

Three times the present age of Sujatha is 5 years more than two times the present age of Vanita.

After 3 years, three times the age of Vanita will be 4 years less than four times the age of Sujatha

Calculation:

Let the present age of Vanita be V

Let the present age of Sujatha be S

⇒ 3S - 5 = 2V

⇒ 3S - 2V = 5 ..(1)

⇒ 3(V + 3) + 4 = 4(S + 3)

⇒ 4S - 3V = 1..(2)

Solving both 1 and 2.

V = 17 and S = 13

According to the question;

V - S = K

k = 17 - 13 = 4 years

**The answer is 4 years.**
